scenes.title: Where and when
narration: Tsutsube originated among the Basarwa (San) people in the Ghanzi and Kgalagadi regions of Botswana.
It has since spread to most parts of Botswana and some areas of the North West province of South Africa.
The dance is traditionally linked to key life stages and spiritual healing rituals.

scenes.title: When it is danced
narration: Tsutsube is performed during four ritual occasions marking important life stages: the first kill for boys, puberty rites, marriage ceremonies, and trance dances for healing and spiritual engagement with ancestors.
Today it is a living tradition.

music_brief.prompt: Original instrumental composition in the musical world of Tsutsube (Botswana). New melody, new arrangement: do not quote or imitate any specific recorded song; keep the idiom, the instruments, the pulse and the proportions.

rules: Original composition only — no sampling, no melody of any existing recording, no lyrics from any song.
